privacy.intro: Santykių Klausimai ("we", "us", or "our") operates the website santykiuklausimai.lt. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via email or a prominent notice on the website at least 30 days before they take effect. Continued use of the service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
changes.title: 9. Changes to This Policy

children.content:
Our service is not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 16 without parental consent. The "Kids" game mode is designed to be played with parental supervision and does not require a personal account.

If you believe a child under 16 has provided us with personal data, please contact us and we will promptly delete it.
children.title: 8. Children's Privacy

contact.content:
For questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, contact us at:

Email: info@santykiuklausimai.lt

We aim to respond within 5 business days.
contact.title: 10. Contact

cookies.content:
Essential cookies: The "payload-token" cookie authenticates your session. This is required for the service to function.

Analytics: We collect anonymous usage data (questions viewed, session duration) only if you accept analytics in the cookie consent banner.

Local storage: We store your game preferences (selected audience, category filters, spicy card settings) and cookie consent choice in your browser's local storage. This data never leaves your device.
cookies.title: 5. Cookies and Local Storage

dataCollected.content:
Account data: When you sign in with Google, we receive your email address, name, and profile picture.

Game data: Questions you view, skip, answer, or mark as favorites. Time spent on each question. Your selected audience and categories.

Session data: Device type, browser language, session duration, and anonymous session identifiers.

Payment data: Your subscription plan and Stripe customer ID. We do not store your credit card details — these are handled entirely by Stripe.

User-submitted content: Questions you submit for review, along with the selected audience.

Streak data: Your current streak, longest streak, and last played date.
dataCollected.title: 1. Data We Collect

legalBasis.content:
We process your data based on the following legal grounds under GDPR Article 6(1):

• Contract (Art. 6(1)(b)): To provide the game service, manage your account, and process payments.
• Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): For analytics cookies and optional data collection. You can withdraw consent at any time.
• Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)): For security monitoring and service improvement.
legalBasis.title: 3. Legal Basis for Processing

purpose.content:
We use your data to:

• Provide and personalize the game experience
• Save your progress across devices
• Process subscription payments
• Calculate and display your play streaks
• Generate anonymous usage statistics to improve the game
• Moderate user-submitted questions
• Communicate important service updates
purpose.title: 2. How We Use Your Data

retention.content:
Account and game data: Retained while your account is active. Deleted within 30 days of account deletion.

Payment records: Retained for 10 years as required by Lithuanian accounting legislation.

Anonymous analytics: Session data is retained for 2 years, then automatically deleted.

User-submitted questions: Retained indefinitely if approved and published. Rejected submissions are deleted within 90 days.
retention.title: 6. Data Retention

rights.content:
Under GDPR, you have the right to:

• Access: Request a copy of your personal data.
• Rectification: Correct inaccurate data.
• Erasure: Delete your account and all associated data.
• Restriction: Limit how we process your data.
• Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format.
• Objection: Object to processing based on legitimate interest.
• Withdraw consent: Revoke analytics consent at any time.

To exercise these rights, contact us at info@santykiuklausimai.lt. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the State Data Protection Inspectorate of Lithuania (VDAI) at vdai.lrv.lt.
rights.title: 7. Your Rights

thirdParties.content:
We share data with the following processors, each operating under their own privacy policies:

• Google (authentication): Processes your sign-in data. Privacy policy: policies.google.com/privacy
• Stripe (payments): Processes payment information. Privacy policy: stripe.com/privacy
• Vercel (hosting and analytics): Hosts the application and provides speed insights. Privacy policy: vercel.com/legal/privacy-policy
thirdParties.title: 4. Third-Party Processors
